title: Devices have not checked in recently

maxStalePct.text: Share of the estate before this is worth reporting

staleDays.text: Days without contact before a device is treated as stale

report.title: {Items.Count} Windows {Plural(Items.Count, 'device has', 'devices have')} not checked in for more than {params.staleDays} days

messages.businessImpact: No policy, no update and no compliance evaluation is reaching these devices. Depending on the tenant settings they may still be counted as compliant and still hold valid access.
remediation: Establish whether they are decommissioned, in storage, or genuinely in use and failing to connect.
Enable a cleanup rule so decommissioned devices are removed automatically rather than accumulating.
messages.cannotSee: How long a device may be quiet before it matters depends on how the organisation works: a machine in a drawer between projects and one that has failed to connect look identical here. Only the last check-in Intune records is read, so a device talking to Entra but not to Intune reads as silent.
